predecessors.name: Zhou dynasty
predecessors.text: Tan, 'located just east of present-day Jinan'; capital Mingshui (Zhangqiu), Shandong

successors.name: Qi (state)
successors.text: Tan, 'located just east of present-day Jinan'; capital Mingshui (Zhangqiu), Shandong

ledger.x: 1046: King Wu founds Tan among the small vassal states after Muye.
684: Duke Huan of Qi conquers Tan.
684: the state of Tan ends (infobox 'Disestablished: 684 BCE').

wars.name: Qi conquest of Tan
wars.outcome: Qi besieged and occupied Tan's capital for three years from 684 BC and then made the ruler its vassal; the infobox ends the state in 684.

certainty.note: No Tan boundary is on the page; the capital site itself is contested (Mingshui or Tancheng).
